project_type: Electron desktop app (Node.js main process + Lit web components renderer)
build_system: Electron Forge - no build step, plain JS loaded via script tags. nodeIntegration: true, contextIsolation: false
test_framework: No automated test suite - validation is via node --check for syntax and manual runtime testing
build_command: node -e "const files = require('glob').sync('src/**/*.js'); files.forEach(f => { try { require('./' + f) } catch(e) { if (e instanceof SyntaxError) { console.error(f, e.message); process.exit(1); } } })" OR find src -name '*.js' -exec node --check {} +
verification_instructions: 1. Run node --check on all .js files in src/typing/ to verify no syntax errors. 2. Verify require() resolution by loading src/typing/index.js in node. 3. Verify all new backends extend BaseBackend and implement required methods.
setup_instructions: npm install (but no new dependencies needed - all backends use built-in Node.js modules and PowerShell/system executables)
environment_constraints: Cannot run Electron app in sandbox. Cannot run PowerShell (not Windows). Validation limited to AST/syntax checks and module resolution testing. No Docker daemon available.
contribution_requirements: Run npx prettier --write . before committing. 4-space indentation, single quotes, semicolons, 150 print width.
key_patterns: All backends extend BaseBackend. Async inject() methods. PowerShell-based backends use Base64 encoding for text to prevent command injection. Use execFile not exec. child_process calls use windowsHide: true and timeouts. EventEmitter pattern for status events. Storage uses JSON files with getters/setters. Lit components use static styles and properties.
directory_structure: src/typing/ - core typing engine. src/typing/backends/ - injection backends. src/components/views/ - Lit settings UI. src/storage.js - persistent config. src/index.js - main process IPC. src/utils/window.js - hotkeys. src/utils/renderer.js - renderer API.
